title: Get TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the information of TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaigns. ## Comparing TCM and TTO Creator Marketplace endpoints The following table outlines the differences between TCM and TTO Creator Marketplace endpoints. ```xtable | Changes {24%}| TCM Endpoint{32%} | TTO Creator Marketplace Endpoint{44%} | |---|---|---| | Endpoint path | /v1.3/tcm/order/get/v2/| /v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/ | | Same request parameters| `page`
`page_size`| `page`
`page_size` | | Deprecated request parameters | N/A |`tcm_account_id`
`query_type`
`order_ids`
`campaign_code`
`invite_link`
`fields`| | New request parameters |N/A | `tto_tcm_account_id`
`campaign_ids`
`campaign_type` | |Same response parameters| `orders.video_ids`
`page_info`
`page_info.page`
`page_info.page_size`
`page_info.total_number`
`page_info.total_page` | `campaigns.video_ids`
`page_info`
`page_info.page`
`page_info.page_size`
`page_info.total_number`
`page_info.total_page` | |Deprecated response parameters | N/A |`orders`
`orders.order_id`

`orders.quota.per_creator_video_limit`
`orders.quota.total_video_limit` | |New response parameters | N/A |`campaigns`
`campaigns.campaign_id`
`campaigns.brand_name`
`campaigns.campaign_name`

`business_account_handle`
`dm_allowed`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | campaign_ids | string[] | The ID list of TikTok One Creator Marketplace campaigns.

Max size: 5.

To create a campaign and obtain the campaign ID, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693549459458). | | campaign_type | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum value:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
Default value: `CAMPAIGN`. | | page | integer | Current page number.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1. | | page_size | integer | Page size.

Value range: 1-5.
Default value: 5.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}&campaign_ids=["{{campaign_id}}","{{campaign_id}}"]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{35%}|Type{15%}|Description{50%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| campaigns | object[] | The list of TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns. | ##| campaign_id | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. | ##| campaign_type | string | The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: A campaign with a [campaign-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Campaign-level%20invite%20link).
  • `BRAND_LINK`: A campaign with a [brand-level invite link](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830337139853313#item-link-Brand-level%20invite%20link).
| ##| brand_profile_id | string | The ID of the Brand Profile associated with the campaign. | ##| brand_name | string | Brand name. | ##| campaign_name | string | Campaign name. | ##| handle_names | string[] | The handle name list of TikTok creators that the campaign is for.
  • If this field is not empty, the campaign is a campaign that only the invited creators can join.
  • If this field is empty, the campaign is a campaign that any creator can join.
| ##| campaign_description | string | Campaign description. | ##|anchor_id|string|The ID of the anchor that is associated with the campaign.| ##| video_ids | string[] | List of video IDs linked to the campaign. | ##| advertiser_ids | string[] | A list of ad accounts that the campaign is associated with.
When a creator's video is linked to the campaign, these ad accounts will automatically be granted Spark Ads authorization for the video. | ##| spark_ads_requested_authorization_days | integer | The default Spark Ads authorization days for videos uploaded to the campaign.

 Enum values: 0, 7, 30, 60, 180, 365. | ##| invite_link | string | The invite link that is associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. | ##| create_time | string | The time when the campaign was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`(UTC+0 time).

Example: `2024-01-01 00:00:01`. | ##| country_codes | string[] | The list of country or region codes associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign.

This field represents the regions where the creators invited to the campaign are located. To learn about the values that might be returned for this field, see [Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010).

You can pass the field value to the Header parameter `Country-Code` in [/tto/tcm/report/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693573340162) to obtain video-level reports for a specific region for a TikTok One Creator Marketplace campaign.

Example: `CA`. | #| page_info | object | Page information. | ##| page | number | Current page number. | ##| page_size| number | Page size. | ##| total_number | number | Total number of results. | ##| total_page | number | Total number of pages. | #|dm_info|string|Direct messaging link information.| ##|business_account_handle|string|The handle (username) of the Business Account.| ##|dm_allowed|boolean|Whether direct messaging is allowed.
Supported values: `true`(allowed), `false`(not allowed).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaigns": [ { "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "campaign_description": "{{campaign_description}}", "anchor_id": null, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "country_codes": [ "US" ], "create_time": "2024-10-03 19:32:04", "handle_names": [ "{{handle_name}}" ], "invite_link": "https://www.tiktok.com/t/1111/", "spark_ads_requested_authorization_days": 0, "video_ids": [] }, { "campaign_type": "CAMPAIGN", "brand_name": "{{brand_name}}", "campaign_description": "{{campaign_description}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "country_codes": [ "US" ], "create_time": "2024-09-25 20:47:49", "handle_names": [ "{{handle_name}}" ], "invite_link": "https://www.tiktok.com/t/333333/", "spark_ads_requested_authorization_days": 0, "advertiser_ids":[], "video_ids": [ "{{video_id}}" ] } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 5, "total_number": 2, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
